summary: Verified both web-panel UI changes on customer dashboard & booking checkout. Task 3 (Explore Services tiles free, no card wrapper) and Task 5 (FeeInfoTip ⓘ next to Platform fee + Est. Govt. Taxes in Step 5 Summary and Step 6 Review) both PASS. Had to recreate missing backend/.env to unblock backend (502). Did NOT test Expo customer/partner native apps (out of scope per request).

critical.issue: /app/backend/.env was missing → backend crashed on startup with KeyError: 'MONGO_URL'. Public URL returned 502 for all /api/*. Recreated with MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017, DB_NAME=test_database, CORS_ORIGINS=* and backend came up.

task3_explore_services_tiles.note: Popular Services card wrappers below still render as cards (expected per code).

task5_fee_info_tip.tooltip_default_text_platform_fee: A small platform fee helps us run the app, provide support and keep your bookings secure.
task5_fee_info_tip.tooltip_default_text_tax: Estimated government taxes (GST) applicable on this order. The exact amount is confirmed before payment.
task5_fee_info_tip.note: Count=2 because tip renders in both main 'Price details'/'Payment summary' and sticky 'Your order' sidebar. Hover reliably opens tooltip; click also toggles state but closes on mouseleave (expected per FeeInfoTip component).

action_items: Investigate why /app/backend/.env went missing — may indicate a reset step wiped env files. Confirm correct production MONGO_URL / DB_NAME values (I used generic defaults sufficient for dev).
critical_code_review_comments: FeeInfoTip: using hover + click dual pattern can be confusing on touch devices — clicking opens then mouseleave of parent span immediately closes it; consider decoupling touch vs desktop behavior (not blocking).
web_panel/src/pages/customer/CustomerDashboard.jsx is ~1855 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline, consider splitting.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing Priya Verma demo customer + Door Repair service for checkout flow)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both tasks visually and programmatically verified. To re-test Task 5, hover (not click) over fee-info buttons to inspect tooltip. Checkout flow: Login as Customer → open Door Repair (svc id f3e55bf5-6400-4a05-afeb-c8c385b9e9dc) → Book Now → Go to checkout → click Continue 4 times to reach Step 5 Summary. Backend .env was missing on this preview; recreated.
rca of the issue: N/A — no app bugs. Only env setup issue (missing backend/.env) blocking initial app access; fixed.
